name: KR Customizer
author: krcustomizer

sections.description:
KR Customizer is a comprehensive product customization solution built specifically for WooCommerce stores. It enables customers to personalize products using interactive 2D and 3D design tools, providing an engaging shopping experience for a wide variety of industries such as apparel, automotive, home décor, packaging, gifting, and more.

Customers can modify product attributes, choose colors, upload images, add custom text, switch styles, and preview changes instantly—all directly on the product page. Merchants can configure customization options easily from the admin panel, ensuring seamless integration with WooCommerce’s product, cart, checkout, and order flows.

Key Features

  • 2D & 3D Customization Interface
    Provide customers with intuitive tools for editing products in flat (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) environments.

  • Live Preview
    Customers see updates instantly as they change colors, upload images, add artwork, or modify attributes.

  • Unlimited Custom Options
    Add unlimited customization elements such as text fields, color choices, shapes, artwork, or layered components.

  • WooCommerce Integration
    Customizations are saved with WooCommerce orders and visible in the order details for both customers and administrators.

  • Responsive & Mobile-Friendly
    The interface adapts automatically to mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

  • Multi-Industry Support
    Suitable for clothing, accessories, auto parts, home décor, packaging, corporate gifting, and any personalized product.

Benefits

  • Enhance customer engagement through interactive product customization
  • Improve conversions with real-time previews
  • Offer personalized experiences that boost customer confidence
  • Increase average order value by enabling premium customization features
  • Provide merchants a flexible and robust customization system without writing code

Terms & Privacy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/krcustomizer/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to KR Customizer > Settings to configure global options.
  4. Edit any WooCommerce product to enable and configure customization settings.
sections.faq:
Does KR Customizer work with all themes?

Yes. KR Customizer is built following WordPress and WooCommerce standards and works with any well-coded theme.

Are 3D models supported?

Yes. You can upload supported 3D model formats to enable 3D customization on compatible products.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the customization interface is fully responsive.

Can I restrict customization to specific products?

Yes. You can enable or disable customization per product.

Where are customization details stored?

All details are saved with the WooCommerce order and are visible in the order admin panel.
